correctness.rationale: An all-positive star reaches exactly two constant final words and their one-leaf flips: the first ignition is center or leaf, and in the latter case the center spreads next and at most one other leaf can be ignited before all remaining leaves inherit its colour. All these patterns have legal sequences. Switching proves the arbitrary-signature code. Distances to the two center-sign halves are max(0,q-1) and max(1,n-q), yielding the formula, the binomial weight distribution, covering radius and exact deep-hole weights. A direct signed state-process census for all 504 signings n=3..8 matched every reachable word and plurality; all normalized binary words n=9..15 were tested by independent Hamming minimization. Finite checks are supplementary, not proof.
